beats.say: Ladybird, the independent open-source web browser built from scratch, has reached its first alpha release.
When you pwn us, please tell us how so we can harden Ladybird! Ladybird improves quickly, and until now you had to build it from source to see that.
The alpha is a rolling channel, and we’ll be pushing out automatic updates regularly. There’s still a mountain of work ahead of us, but I’m very happy that you can finally try Ladybird for yourself!
